description: Source code for the GitManager class implementing Git operations using libgit2, including repository initialization, cloning, remote management, commit, push, fetch, merge, reset, and log retrieval.
external_files: libgit2 library headers (implied by functions like git_repository_free, git_clone, etc.)

classes.name: GitManager
classes.description: Class encapsulating Git repository management operations using libgit2.

methods.name: GitManager
methods.description: Default constructor, initializes libgit2 and internal state.

methods.name: GitManager
methods.description: Constructor with user credentials and signature, initializes repository with provided info.

methods.name: ~GitManager
methods.description: Destructor, frees repository resources and shuts down libgit2.

methods.name: setUserPass
methods.description: Sets username and password for authentication.

methods.name: setSignature
methods.description: Sets user signature for commits.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes libgit2 and resets internal variables.

methods.name: initLocalRepo
methods.description: Initializes a local repository at specified directory, optionally creates initial commit.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Clones a repository from URL to specified path.

methods.name: createInitialCommit
methods.description: Creates the first commit in a new repository.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens an existing repository.

methods.name: addRemote
methods.description: Adds a remote with given name and URL.

methods.name: removeRemote
methods.description: Removes a remote by name.

methods.name: renameRemote
methods.description: Renames a remote.

methods.name: setUrlRemote
methods.description: Sets URL for a remote, optionally for push.

methods.name: getRemoteList
methods.description: Retrieves list of remotes.

methods.name: clearRemoteList
methods.description: Removes all remotes.

methods.name: getStatusList
methods.description: Gets list of repository status entries.

methods.name: addAll
methods.description: Stages all changes.

methods.name: commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with the given message.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Pushes local commits to remote.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Fetches updates from remote, with optional pruning.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Performs a merge operation.

methods.name: resetHard
methods.description: Resets the repository to HEAD hard.

methods.name: pull
methods.description: Performs pull operation: commit, fetch, merge, push if needed.

methods.name: commitA
methods.description: Adds all changes and commits.

methods.name: commitU
methods.description: Merges remote changes with local, resolving conflicts.

methods.name: getLogList
methods.description: Retrieves recent commit logs.

methods.name: getOidByGitCommit
methods.description: Returns string representation of commit's OID.

methods.name: test
methods.description: Test method with sample repository operations.
